event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your physical therapy referral request in this message thread today during service hours. On the facts you've reported — years of on-and-off pain, no new injury, no numbness or weakness — urgent or in-person care doesn't appear needed now, pending that clinician's screening. If you develop numbness in the groin or buttocks, trouble passing urine, new loss of bladder or bowel control, or new leg weakness, go to an emergency department immediately without waiting for a message reply. If you develop fever with back pain, unexplained weight loss, or pain that wakes you at night, seek prompt clinician assessment; if that review isn't available, arrange a same-day in-person appointment.
